snippet.title: Zero Parades: Director's Cut - Official Xbox Release Date Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the Xbox Trailer for Zero Parades: Director's Cut, an espionage RPG developed by ZA/UM. Players will endure the trials and tribulations of a single operative on one final mission. The latest update is packed with more material, revisions, improvements, and more. Zero Parades: Director's Cut is launching on November 3 for Xbox Series X|S and PC.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
